correctness.rationale: For each source pencil, exact determinant expansion in two normal coordinates gives the degree-two normal form \(Au^2+Buv+Cv^2\). Fresh independent symbolic reconstruction reproduced all five package factorizations of \(B^2-4AC\). Every factor is a positive-definite real binary quadratic with nonzero discriminant and the two factors in each row are coprime. Thus the discriminant is strictly positive on \(\mathbb RP^1\), giving two distinct real tangent planes at every real point, while its four complex projective zeros are simple and nonreal.
